summary: Tested site content management (iteration 5): /api/site public endpoint with computed stats + {live} replacement, admin layout/home endpoints with role checks (403 for student), legal pages CRUD with slug validation + draft 404 behavior. 13/13 pytest tests pass. Playwright E2E verified: Home renders brand/hero/stats/features from backend, footer visible on public but hidden on /admin, admin sidebar has all 4 Settings entries (Site Settings, Home Page, Legal Pages, Payment Settings), save buttons present, created & viewed a page at /page/<slug> with rendered markdown, cleaned up afterwards. Payment Settings still works.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby — React warning in console; accessibility only, non-blocking

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Legal Page edit/create dialog to silence Radix a11y warning
critical_code_review_comments: site_routes.save() stores metrics/computed fields inside DEFAULTS merge pattern — current logic merges only known keys which is good; no leaks.
update_page uses _clean(data, page_id) which correctly excludes current id when checking duplicate slug.
Pydantic max_length=6 on stats is enforced (422 returned on 7 stats — verified).
_compact rounding: '{n/1000:.1f}'.rstrip('0').rstrip('.') + 'K+' may produce weird edge cases for exact thousand (e.g. 1000 -> '1K+'), acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created /page/test-e2e-page via Legal Pages admin flow; deleted after verification. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 covered new site/home/footer/legal-pages features end-to-end. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py. Public site data is driven by SiteProvider on frontend; metrics come from counts over users/questions/tests/test_attempts collections. Admin sidebar now has 4 entries under Settings group.
